fact: UNHCR states that Ordinance 002/PR/2020 of 14 February 2020 on civil status, ratified by Law 006/PR/2020 of 29 May 2020, sets up the integrated population and secure titles system (SIGPTS) run by ANATS, which issues a unique national identification number (NNI) through the national biometric population register (RNBP).

UNHCR states that under Ordinance 002/PR/2020 (article 8) the RNBP holds biographic and biometric data and the NNI of everyone on the territory, article 2 obliges every resident or visitor to register, and article 10 makes the NNI unique, unintelligible and non-sequential.
